PURPOSE OF CONSULTANCY
The consultant will support the epidemiological surveillance of zoonotic diseases,
outbreak investigation in the field and the coordination of laboratory networks
during health emergencies.
DESCRIPTION OF DUTIES
- Support epidemiological surveillance of emerging zoonotic diseases.
- Lead outbreak investigation missions with national teams.
- Coordinate laboratory networks for diagnosis during emergencies.
EDUCATION
University degree in veterinary medicine, epidemiology or public health.
